task: DAY-24 design of predeclared forward OOS duration amendment
title: Design of Predeclared Forward OOS Duration Amendment
governance_mandate: protocol design task only; no strategy evaluation; no forward data acquired, inspected, or calculated; frozen protocol unchanged in this task

executive_summary.problem: The frozen 252-session forward OOS window was sized in DAY-16 to accommodate 3 concurrent families, particularly V2-LRV's 126-session pairs trading period (2 x 126 = 252). With V2-LRV and V2-STR stopped, V2-MOM is the sole surviving strategy. 252 sessions imposes an 11-month idle delay without technical necessity or statistical justification.
executive_summary.rationale: Aligns with standard institutional financial review cycles; captures 3 distinct monthly rebalances across a corporate reporting season; eliminates 75% of waiting latency; preserves 100% of blindness and anti-snooping guarantees via ex-ante precommitment.

candidate_windows_evaluation.methodological_value: Operational smoke test for live fills and corporate action handling
candidate_windows_evaluation.limitations: Single return draw; high noise; vulnerable to 1-month shock

candidate_windows_evaluation.methodological_value: Tests transition between two consecutive monthly portfolios
candidate_windows_evaluation.limitations: Arbitrary non-standard calendar boundary; high short-term noise
Inherited from Yahoo Finance 60-day intraday API limitation; non-standard trading day count

candidate_windows_evaluation.methodological_value: Standard institutional quarterly review cycle; exact quarter division (252 / 4); spans 1 full earnings season; 3 monthly rebalances
candidate_windows_evaluation.limitations: Cannot observe multi-year macroeconomic regime changes
candidate_windows_evaluation.verdict: RECOMMENDED (optimal balance of institutional convention, depth, and latency reduction)

candidate_windows_evaluation.methodological_value: Spans 1/3 of a trading year across two earnings seasons
candidate_windows_evaluation.limitations: Non-standard calendar interval; awkward reporting period

candidate_windows_evaluation.methodological_value: Semi-annual institutional cycle; spans two full earnings cycles; native duration from protocol v2 (§5.3)
Full annual seasonal cycle; 12 monthly rebalances
candidate_windows_evaluation.limitations: Imposes 11-month idle latency; still has low statistical power (§20 Q11)

architecture_A_single_blind_window.description: Exactly 63 XNYS sessions elapse with zero interim peeking; single data acquisition and evaluation at conclusion
architecture_A_single_blind_window.decision_rule_complexity: Zero new rules; retains protocol v2 §13 gate logic verbatim

architecture_B_staged_window.description: Predeclared stages (e.g. 20 + 40 or 30 + 33 sessions) with an intermediate decision rule
architecture_B_staged_window.blindness: Fragile; requires intermediate data exposure or partial blinding
architecture_B_staged_window.anti_snooping: Risk of psychological/governance leakage or adaptive behavior between stages
architecture_B_staged_window.governance_complexity: High (multiple acquisition snapshots and review cycles)
architecture_B_staged_window.decision_rule_complexity: High; an intermediate kill rule on 1 monthly rebalance creates massive false-positive risk
architecture_B_staged_window.verdict: REJECTED (uncalibrated kill rules for monthly momentum; unneeded complexity)

specifications.2_session_count_definition: Exactly 63 consecutive trading sessions of the New York Stock Exchange (XNYS), resolved by exchange_calendars 4.13.2
specifications.3_start_date_rule: First XNYS session strictly after protocol freeze commit date: 2026-10-08
specifications.4_end_date_rule: 63rd XNYS session: 2027-01-07 inclusive; final liquidation at close of session 63
specifications.5_data_acquisition: Stage F acquired strictly after 16:15 ET on 2027-01-07; Series A raw OHLC and Alpaca corporate actions from 2025-01-02 to 2027-01-07; single idempotent pass into data/oos_cache/protocol_v2/stage_f/
specifications.6_data_prohibition: Zero forward market data dated after 2026-10-07 may be acquired, queried, or inspected prior to 16:15 ET on 2027-01-07; operational feeds must isolate ingestion and never calculate forward strategy performance
specifications.7_interim_evaluation: Strictly prohibited; zero interim CAGR, Sharpe, Drawdown, PnL, or return tracking
specifications.8_final_evaluation_trigger: Triggered once after session 63 completion and Stage F data validation pass
specifications.9_decision_rules: Unchanged protocol v2 §13 gates at 5 bps: Gate 1 (net CAGR >= 0), Gate 2 (net CAGR >= B1 net CAGR over identical 63 sessions), Gate A (integrity), Gate C (completeness)
specifications.10_partial_calendar_years: CAGR annualized as (E_T / E_0)^(252 / 63) - 1; subperiods for 2026 and 2027 explicitly labelled as partial
specifications.11_determinism: Two independent runs must produce byte-identical fill logs, equity curves, and metrics
specifications.12_reproducibility: Full §17 reproducibility block matching environment and configuration
specifications.13_operational_failures: Unscheduled closures advance the session calendar until 63 sessions are reached; missingness > 2% halts for protocol-owner review without imputation
specifications.14_strategy_scope: Applies exclusively to V2-MOM (V2-MOM-F001); V2-LRV and V2-STR remain permanently stopped
specifications.15_strategy_parameters: Zero parameter changes; strategy config SHA-256 62827d70... is 100% invariant
